notToBeConfusedWith.name: VAOC (build-time)
notToBeConfusedWith.difference: VAOC is the Claude Code subagent company that writes this repo. VOAC ships inside the product. Same primitive, different lifetime.

nodes.label: Group Broker
nodes.summary: The ONLY supervisor. Holds the cross-company view and the standing to arbitrate between two companies' P&Ls — the one layer that has something its subordinates lack.
invariants: companyId is NULL — it belongs to the group, never to one company
Runs `parallel`: two P&Ls means competing objectives
Must state a transfer-pricing basis before proposing an intercompany move
Cannot propose perishables across a border

nodes.label: skill.md
nodes.summary: Instructions as a trainable markdown document

nodes.label: AgentStep
nodes.summary: One step; parentStepId keeps fan-out distinguishable from hand-off

nodes.label: score
nodes.summary: Nullable — unscored must stay visibly unscored

nodes.label: Proposal budget
nodes.summary: Hard cap per human per day. Ranks on expected value; reports everything it held back.

nodes.label: Human commits
nodes.summary: A named approver. Liability sits with whoever clicked.

nodes.label: Outcome recorded
nodes.summary: Realized value, 30–60 days later. The only non-circular signal in the system.

nodes.label: SkillOpt (offline, CI only)
nodes.summary: Trains the markdown skill documents against recorded outcomes and ships a static best_skill.md. Python + long-running loop, so it can never run in the Worker — which is why runtime inference cost is unchanged.
invariants: Never runs at request time — zero extra inference calls
At one client there is no held-out distribution: today this is a regression suite, NOT training
Never train on self-assessed scores alone — that reward is circular

models.name: VoacRoster
models.summary: Which roles are active for one company. A roster is DATA, not an org layer: there is no per-company supervisor agent, because a supervisor over co-located agents has neither information nor authority its subordinates lack. It would be a pass-through that costs a hop.

models.name: AgentRun
models.summary: One invocation of the VOAC: a role (or the Group Broker) pursuing one objective under one orchestration topology.

models.name: AgentStep
models.summary: One step inside a run. parentStepId makes the tree explicit, so a fan-out (parallel) and a hand-off (chain) are distinguishable after the fact instead of flattened into an undifferentiated log.

models.name: AgentProposal
models.summary: What an agent asks a human to do. The read-mostly boundary made durable: the VOAC writes rows HERE, never to domain tables. A proposal becomes real only when a named human commits it through the ordinary server action.

invariants.title: Exactly one supervisor
invariants.body: A supervisor over agents that share a company holds neither information nor authority its subordinates lack — a pass-through that costs a hop. Only the Group Broker qualifies.

invariants.title: The proposal queue is capped
invariants.body: An uncapped queue is either ignored or rubber-stamped, and rubber-stamping silently deletes the human gate. Precision is the product; recall is a liability.

invariants.title: Read-mostly
invariants.body: The VOAC writes AgentProposal rows and nothing else. Domain mutations go through the ordinary server actions.

invariants.title: A refusal is still a row
invariants.body: Refused runs are written with status "REFUSED" and a reason. "The agent declined" must be answerable from the ledger, not invisible.

invariants.title: A finished run never reopens
invariants.body: An audit trail that can be rewritten is not an audit trail.

invariants.title: Two keys: tenantId isolates, companyId organises
invariants.body: An AgentStep's output quotes the tenant's own documents, so a scoping bug leaks source data — not merely metadata.

openQuestions: No LLM execution driver yet — wiring must reuse brain/orchestrator.ts and council.live.ts, not reimplement debate.
No UI surface. The ledger has no screen yet.
SkillOpt has no held-out distribution at one client; treat as regression suite until proposal volume and a second reviewer exist.
The flagship cross-company flow is bounded by the hotels' purchasing cycle, which is not yet recorded anywhere.
